name: Insert C_Day.txt
content:
INSERT INTO C_Day (C_Day_ID, AD_Client_ID, AD_Org_ID, IsActive, Created, CreatedBy, Updated, UpdatedBy, C_Period_ID, Date1, Day1, WeekDay, IsHoliday) 
SELECT 
  -- C_Day_ID starting at 1000000 plus ROW_NUMBER()
  1000000 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d.dt) AS C_Day_ID,
  0 AS AD_Client_ID,
  0 AS AD_Org_ID,
  'Y' AS IsActive,
  SYSDATE AS Created,
  100 AS CreatedBy,
  SYSDATE AS Updated,
  100 AS UpdatedBy,
  p.C_Period_ID,
  d.dt AS Date1,
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM d.dt) AS Day1,
  -- Weekday name in English (e.g. 'Monday')
  TO_CHAR(d.dt, 'FMDay', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS WeekDay,
  'N' AS IsHoliday
FROM (
  SELECT DATE '2020-01-01' + LEVEL - 1 AS dt
  FROM dual
  CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (DATE '2030-12-31' - DATE '2020-01-01' + 1)
) d
JOIN C_Period p ON d.dt BETWEEN p.StartDate AND p.EndDate;

name: SCRIPT-FIX-M_StorageOnHand-OLD.sql
description: Fix the mismatch between On Hand qty and item card **OLD**
content:
UPDATE M_STORAGEONHAND s
SET S.QTYONHAND =
(SELECT SUM (t.movementqty)
FROM M_TRANSACTION t
WHERE T.M_PRODUCT_ID = s.M_PRODUCT_ID
AND t.m_locator_id = s.m_locator_id
AND t.m_attributesetinstance_id = S.M_ATTRIBUTESETINSTANCE_ID)

name: SCRIPT-FIX-M_StorageOnHand.sql
description: Fix the mismatch between On Hand qty and item card **New Version**
content:
UPDATE M_STORAGEONHAND s
SET S.QTYONHAND =
NVL((SELECT SUM (t.movementqty)
FROM M_TRANSACTION t
WHERE T.M_PRODUCT_ID = s.M_PRODUCT_ID
AND t.m_locator_id = s.m_locator_id
AND t.m_attributesetinstance_id =
S.M_ATTRIBUTESETINSTANCE_ID),0)

/* Formatted on 03/07/2023 02:08:48 ? (QP5 v5.256.13226.35510) */
SELECT E.GRANDTOTAL,F.AMTACCTDR, F.RECORD_ID,E.DATEINVOICED,E.DOCUMENTNO
  FROM c_invoice e
       JOIN (  SELECT SUM (t.AMTACCTDR) AMTACCTDR, t.RECORD_ID
                 FROM fact_aCCT t
                WHERE T.AD_TABLE_ID = 318
             GROUP BY t.RECORD_ID) F
          ON F.RECORD_ID = E.C_INVOICE_ID
 WHERE     e.isSotrx = 'Y'
       AND TO_CHAR (e.dateinvoiced, 'yyyy') = TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'yyyy')
       AND e.c_pos_id IS NOT NULL
       AND E.GRANDTOTAL <> F.AMTACCTDR;
